faqs: How much do channel letters cost in Jacksonville?
Most storefront channel-letter sets run $2,500–$12,000+ installed. Letter height and count, illumination type, materials, mounting, and permitting drive the price.

They can be. Front-lit letters glow through the face, halo-lit (reverse) letters cast a backlit glow on the wall, and dimensional letters are non-lit. We'll recommend the right type for your brand and building.
How long do channel letters take to install?
Typically 4–8 weeks from approval, covering design, county permitting, in-house fabrication, and installation with electrical for lit sets.
